meta_description: Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia 2026 Manila Leg 3: September 6. 32K, 21K, 10K, 5K from Runrio.
dek: Set for 6 September 2026 in Manila, this Runrio-produced Sante Barley series leg features the rare 32K distance as the Metro Manila finale.
verdict: The Sante Barley Trilogy Run Manila Leg 3 brings the rare 32K distance to Metro Manila as the series' capital-region finale. Produced by Runrio, it also offers standard 21K, 10K, and 5K distances. The 32K is a genuine stepping-stone for marathon aspirants in the country's largest running community. September in Manila is the tail of the wet season. A distinctive Runrio-produced Manila series leg with the unusual 32K option — likely the most competitive field in the Sante Barley series.
